name: microservice-input
services:
  deliver_service:
    build:
      context: /Users/malith_bandara/Desktop/final_research_agentic/data/jobs/424c51d769194039990d15e48068009e/microservice-input/server/deliver-service
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: deliver_service_container
    depends_on:
      mongo:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      order_service:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      MONGO_URL: ""
      NODE_ENV: ""
      ORDER_SERVICE_URL: http://order_service_container:3003
      PORT: "3005"
      SEKRET_KEY: ""
      SERVER_URL: http://localhost:3005
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - -qO-
        - http://localhost:3005/health
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 3
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 3005
        published: "3005"
        protocol: tcp
  frontend:
    build:
      context: /Users/malith_bandara/Desktop/final_research_agentic/data/jobs/424c51d769194039990d15e48068009e/microservice-input/client
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: frontend_container
    depends_on:
      deliver_service:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
      notification_service:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
      order_service:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
      payment_service:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
      restaurant_service:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
      user_service:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
    environment:
      PORT: "5173"
      VITE_DELIVER_SERVICE_URL: http://localhost:3005
      VITE_NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_URL: http://localhost:3006
      VITE_ORDER_SERVICE_URL: http://localhost:3003
      VITE_PAYMENT_SERVICE_URL: http://localhost:3004
      VITE_RESTAURANT_SERVICE_URL: http://localhost:3002
      VITE_USER_SERVICE_URL: http://localhost:3000
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 5173
        published: "5173"
        protocol: tcp
    stdin_open: true
    tty: true
  mongo:
    container_name: mongo_container
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mongosh
        - --eval
        - db.adminCommand('ping')
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 3
    image: mongo:latest
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 27017
        published: "27017"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: mongo_data
        target: /data/db
        volume: {}
  notification_service:

      context: /Users/malith_bandara/Desktop/final_research_agentic/data/jobs/424c51d769194039990d15e48068009e/microservice-input/server/notification-server
